title: RNA splicing evidence enables robust classification of BRCA1 exon 18 variants: Results from the ENIGMA consortium.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, not open access in Europe PMC, no supplement listing, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits on the DOI.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: All counts (166 variants by minigene assay, 32 in blood RNA from 51 individuals, 18 in mouse embryonic stem cell repair assays) come from the abstract only.

a1_downloadable.note: Paywalled paper, no PMCID, no supplement or repository deposit found; per-variant splicing table not retrievable. Checked via paper_context.py only.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Unknown; per-variant splicing percentages (full-length and exon-18-skipped transcript levels) are presumably in a supplementary table we could not see.

a3_inputs_present.note: Variant identities not seen; would be HGVS (standard variant notation) names, convertible to sequence via the reference genome.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked; abstract reports percent of full-length transcript.

a5_enough_rows.note: Abstract states 166 variants, well below the ~400 minimum even for classification; not verified in files.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: <1 MB (one small table, if it existed)

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No files to compare against the abstract.

a8_label_provenance.note: Labels would be measured minigene RT-PCR (reverse-transcription PCR) splicing readouts, a physical measurement; not a model output.

backbone.name: SpliceAI or AlphaGenome (DNA splicing predictors) as feature sources

integration.partner_dataset: ClinVar / BRCA Exchange; BRCA1 saturation genome editing (Findlay et al. 2018) covers other exons
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Not assessed because Part A failed.

controls.positive_control: Canonical splice-site (±1/2) variants should show near-complete exon skipping.

honest_claim_h3: At best: predicts minigene-measured exon 18 splicing for 166 hand-picked BRCA1 variants in one exon, too few for a learned model.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the DNA change of a BRCA1 exon 18 variant to predict how much normal versus exon-skipped messenger RNA it produces.
plain_idea.train_on: DNA sequence around each variant; 166 variants per the abstract (unverified, table not accessible).
plain_idea.predict: Percent full-length and exon-18-skipped transcript, measured by minigene splicing assays read out with RT-PCR (reverse-transcription PCR).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Clinical variant curators could triage which BRCA1 variants need RNA testing; but 166 variants in one exon is a benchmark for existing splice predictors, not a training set.

ml_idea: Benchmark existing splicing predictors (SpliceAI, AlphaGenome) against the 166 minigene measurements; too small to train on and the table is not accessible.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Whether a per-variant splicing table is downloadable at all (it is not, via open channels).

verdict_reason: Paywalled with no open supplement or deposit (A1), and only 166 variants by the abstract (A5); at most a small benchmark for existing splice predictors.
